description: Agent Oversight: submit an inventory of agent action classes (name, category, gate, the amount or count a threshold fires above, and the most one action or period can carry). The signed report names every consequential class (payments, limit changes, external sends, deletions) with no gate or with a threshold that never fires, the thresholds the material cannot verify, and coverage by category. Controls at the action: approver bands are wever_approval-chain-check and spending policy controls wever_spending-policy-check. Verdict gaps_found, thresholds_unverified or covered. POST /api/action-threshold-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-oversight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-oversight/.

gate.description: The control on it; absent reads as none.

gate_after_count.description: Gate fires after this many per period.

max_amount.description: Largest amount one action can carry.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
